text:
devon: Quick sync — customers pushing hard on audit logs + BYOK for Q2 enterprise launches. Do we have a proposed scope & gating criteria?
maria: Not fully nailed. We sketched BYOK + 1yr audit retention as MVP, SOC2 readiness as parallel work. Need engineering cost estimate.
liam: FYI runtime team: BYOK requires key-rotation hooks + KMS integrations (AWS, GCP, Azure). Also natty for private deploys: HSM interface. Rough estimate: 2 sprints infra + 1 sprint API surface.
emma: Security notes: SOC2 readiness needs continuous logging, proof of encryption at rest, key custody docs. For ISO we'll need evidence of controls mapping — separate deliverable.
alex: Customers (finance vertical) want exportable audit sets and tamper-evident logs. They asked for legal hold + 7 year retention option. That’s a non-trivial ops ask.
maria: We need launch criteria per feature. Proposal: BYOK GA if: 1) KMS integration tests pass, 2) docs + customer onboarding flow, 3) e2e audit example exported. Thoughts?
liam: Agree. Add performance guardrail: <10% p99 latency regression on hosted model paths when BYOK enabled. If exceeded, block GA.
emma: Also add security acceptance: third-party key custody review and threat-model signoff.
compliance-bot: Automated reminder — attach SOC2 evidence checklist to PRs touching audit/logging.
devon: On retention: can we support tiered retention? e.g., default 1y, optional 7y archival export. Need cost estimate and legal constraints.
liam: Implementation idea: writable audit stream -> S3-like object store (encrypted with customer key if BYOK) + immutable manifest. Provide export tool for legal hold.
maria: MVP scope suggestion (small, ship fast): 1) Audit logs: request/response metadata + admin actions, 1yr retention, export API. 2) BYOK: support AWS KMS + GCP KMS, customer-managed keys for at-rest encryption. 3) SOC2: gap analysis doc + remediation tickets.
emma: MVP exclusions (call out): no HSM on-prem GA, no 7y retention baked in (export-only), no formal ISO certification in first release.
alex: Sales needs a customer-facing one-pager for compliance features and a FAQ for BYOK onboarding.
maria: Launch gating checklist draft:
- Functional: audit events captured for all API routes specified
- Security: key lifecycle docs + threat model signoff
- Performance: p99 latency guardrails met
- UX: onboarding flow + API docs + test customer runbook
- Legal: retention export contract language approved

maria: Quick sample retention config for product & docs (for engineering):
```
{
  "audit_retention": "365d",
  "export_on_request": true,
  "archive_policy": {
    "enabled": false,
    "max_age": "2555d" // ~7 years for exports
  }
}
```

liam: Flag: archive_policy.enabled false in MVP — toggling it would incur storage + immutability constraints.
emma: Action items: 1) Security to draft SOC2 gap doc (emma) 2) Eng to prototype BYOK KMS stubs (liam) 3) Product to draft onboarding + contracts (maria) 4) Sales to collect list of customers wanting 7y retention (alex)
devon: Can we put tentative timeline? Recommend: 2 sprints prototype + 2 sprints harden + 1 sprint docs/onboarding = ~5 sprints. Push SOC2 remediation parallel.
maria: Budget ask for exec review: incremental infra + storage + compliance audit cost estimate. I'll circle back with numbers.
alex: I'll set up a customer advisory call next week to validate retention and BYOK priority.
liam: Quick note: include integration tests for key rotation and simulated disaster recovery in acceptance tests.
emma: +1. Also ensure export logs are signed with a manifest so customer can verify integrity.
compliance-bot: Reminder: add ticket to tracker: PROD-4521 (audit logs) and link SOC2 gap doc.
maria: Thanks everyone — I'll draft the PRD + gating checklist and post here for review by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
